paite: Judah kumpipa Uzziah vaihawm lai leh Israel kumpipa Joas tapa Jeroboam vaihawm lai a zinling ma kum nih in, Tekoa mun ganhon veng mite lak a mi Amos thu Israel tungtang amuh:
english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

paite: Huan ama'n, "Zion tang a kipan TOUPA ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; belam veng mite gantatna munte alungkham ding ua, Karmel tang vum avuai ding," achi hi.
english: He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Damaskas kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Gilead gam buhgawina sikte a agawi ziak un.
heading: Namte Tung A Pathian Thukhenna / Siria tung a thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;

paite: Himahleh Hazael inn ah mei ka sawl ding a, Ben-hadad kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.
english: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

paite: Huan Damaskas kho kongkhak sik ka hihtan ding a, Aven Phaizang a kipan luah mite leh Eden inn a kipan kumpipa chiang tawipa ka mangsak ding a; Siria gam mite Kir gam ah sal in a-om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Gaza kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka hihtawp kei ding; Edom kiang a piak ding in mi tengteng sal a api ziak un.
heading: Philistia tung a thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;

paite: Himahleh Gaza kulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.
english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.

paite: Huan Ashdod a kipan luahmi leh Ashkelon a kipan kumpipa chiang tawimi ka hihmang ding a; huan, Ekron kho tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, Philistia mi khosuaksunte amang ding uh," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Tura kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kiang a mi tengteng apiak ua, unau tung a athukhun atheihgige louh ziak un.
heading: Tura tung a thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;

paite: Himahleh Tura khokulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.
english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Edom tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, gawtna ka daisak kei ding; a-unau namsau in adelh a, ahehpihna tengteng apaimang a, ahehna in abotkek gige a, tangtawn a ahehna avom nilouh ziak in.
heading: Edom tung a thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;

paite: Himahleh Teman tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Bozrah kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.
english: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ammon tate tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; agam uh azatsak theihna ding un, Gilead kho numei naupaite akuihkek ziak un.
heading: Ammon tung a thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.

paite: Himahleh Rabbah khokulh tung ah mei ka mutkuang ding a, huan, kidouna ni a kikou toh, pingpei ni a huihpi toh, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding.
english: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;

paite: Akumpipa uh sal in aman ding ua, amiliante toh kiton in," TOUPA'N achi.
english: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says Yahweh.
